name: 守关老卒
text: [坚守]。
flavor: 关早就破了，他还守着那道门槛。

art.subject: a grizzled old gate guard in patched lamellar armor planting a long spear before a ruined stone gateway, feet braced, dusk light behind him

name: 山中猎户
text: [远射]。
flavor: 他只认得两种东西：风向，和猎物。

art.subject: a lean mountain hunter in fur-trimmed hood drawing a horn bow from behind a mossy boulder, pine forest mist, eye narrowed along the arrow

name: 游方剑客
text: [疾行]。
flavor: 剑比人先到，人比名声先走。

art.subject: a wandering swordsman in a travel-worn straw hat mid-dash, blade half drawn from its scabbard, dust kicking up on a dirt road, low sun

name: 夜行客
text: [奇袭]。
flavor: 墙再高，也高不过檐下的影子。

art.subject: a masked night runner in dark wrappings leaping between tiled rooftops under a thin crescent moon, twin short knives reversed along the forearms

name: 扎草人
text: 召唤{n}个具有[坚守]的草人。
flavor: 稻草不怕疼，只怕火。

art.subject: weathered hands binding straw into crude human effigies in a harvested field, two finished scarecrows already standing guard, overcast light

name: 草人
text: [坚守]。
flavor: 它替你挨的每一刀，都不会记仇。

art.subject: a crude straw effigy wearing a torn soldier's tabard, bound to a wooden cross-stake, arrows stuck in its chest, wind tugging loose straw

name: 素心供
text: 抽{n}张牌。[献]：抽{m}张牌。
flavor: 无色之供，神明也挑不出错。

art.subject: a plain white porcelain offering bowl holding a single unlit candle on a bare stone altar, thin smoke of incense curling upward, soft dawn light

name: 五色符
text: 选择一种颜色，本回合获得{n}枚该色的临时[源]。[燃尽]。

upgrade.text: 选择一种颜色，本回合获得{n}枚该色的临时[源]。

flavor: 一张黄纸，五道朱砂。写哪一道，全看你缺哪一口气。

art.subject: a paper talisman held between two fingers, five brush strokes glowing in vermilion, indigo, jade, gold and violet, embers peeling from its edges

name: 掷钱问卦
text: [判定]：阳纹——对目标造成{d}点伤害；阴纹——获得{a}点[护甲]。
flavor: 三枚铜钱落地，字面朝天者进，背面朝天者守。

art.subject: three bronze square-holed coins spinning in midair above an open palm, one landing face up on a cracked tile floor, lantern light glinting off their rims

name: 窥天一隙
text: [窥视]{p}。抽{n}张牌。
flavor: 天幕裂开一道缝，缝里是明天的颜色。

art.subject: a traveler peering through a narrow crack in a night sky rendered as torn silk, glimpsing glowing fate cards arranged beyond, starlight on the face

name: 翻检行囊
text: 抽{n}张牌，然后弃置{k}张牌。
flavor: 干粮、火石、半张地图——还有一块不知谁塞进来的石头。

art.subject: a worn leather travel pack spilled open on a campfire-lit blanket, hands sorting rations, flint, a rolled map and a strange smooth stone

name: 横刀格挡
text: [应]：获得{a}点[护甲]。

upgrade.text: [应]：获得{a}点[护甲]。若在应对窗口中打出，抽{n}张牌。

flavor: 刀背迎上去的那一刻，你已经在想下一招。

art.subject: a fighter catching a heavy downward blow on a horizontally raised saber, sparks bursting at the point of contact, knees bent, rain streaking the dark

name: 挪移阵脚
text: 将一个单位移至另一排（须有空位）。抽{n}张牌。
flavor: 阵不在人多，在脚下那一步。

art.subject: a commander's hand sliding a carved wooden soldier piece across a battle map from the rear line to the front line, candlelight over the table

name: 回风斩
text: 对所有敌方单位造成{d}点伤害。
flavor: 一刀出去，风替你再砍三刀。

art.subject: a warrior spinning low with a long curved blade, a ring of cutting wind flaring outward and scattering fallen leaves, figures recoiling at the edge

name: 拨灯续明
text: 重置{n}枚已用的[源]。
flavor: 灯芯挑一挑，还能再亮一更。

art.subject: a thin bronze pin lifting the wick of a dimming oil lamp, the flame blooming brighter and throwing warm light over a scroll-covered desk at night

name: 双刀客
text: [连斩]。
flavor: 左手问路，右手答话。

art.subject: a broad-shouldered duelist with a saber in each hand crossed low before him, scarf whipping in the wind, standing on a rope bridge over a gorge

name: 护法僧
text: [灵障]。[起势]：你的主帅获得{w}层[灵障]。
flavor: 他念的经没人听得懂，但刀砍上去是真的会停。

art.subject: a bald warrior monk holding prayer beads up in one hand, a translucent golden bell-shaped barrier ringing around him and a figure behind him

name: 蛭巫
text: [汲命]。
flavor: 沼泽里的老妪，放一次血，还你一口气。

art.subject: a hunched swamp witch with leeches coiled around her wrists raising a gnarled staff, crimson threads of life drifting toward her from the fog

name: 断喉
text: 若目标生命值不高于{n}，将其消灭；否则对其造成{d}点伤害。
flavor: 不必多一寸，也不能少一寸。

art.subject: a single thin blade flashing across the frame from the shadows, a severed lantern cord falling, the silhouette of a startled guard beyond

name: 百川归流
text: 你的[源]中每有一种颜色（素色不计），抽{n}张牌。
flavor: 赤水、玄水、青水，流到海里都是一个颜色。

art.subject: several rivers of different tinted waters, red, deep blue and green, braiding together through a valley and pouring into one luminous sea at dusk

name: 行脚货郎
text: [起势]：从三张你流派的随机牌中选择一张加入手牌。

upgrade.text: [起势]：从三张你流派的随机牌中选择一张加入手牌，它已升级。

flavor: “客官，赤的玄的都有，看您今天是什么命。”

art.subject: a cheerful traveling peddler with an enormous lacquered backpack cabinet, drawers open to show glowing cards and trinkets, tipping his hat on a village road

name: 追风骑
text: 进击坐骑：你的主帅攻击距离+{r}。每回合你的主帅第一次攻击时，抽{n}张牌。
flavor: 马比人快一步，刀就能长一尺。

art.subject: a lean chestnut warhorse at full gallop with mane streaming like smoke, empty saddle trimmed in brass, hooves barely touching a windswept plain

name: 负碑玄龟
text: 防御坐骑：你的主帅深度+{r}。回合结束时，获得{a}点[护甲]。
flavor: 碑上的字早磨平了，龟还记得要往哪里走。

art.subject: an enormous ancient black tortoise carrying a weathered stone stele on its shell, a saddle platform built beside the stele, moss and small ferns growing in the cracks

name: 野市
text: 此后{n}个回合，你每回合额外抽{m}张牌。
flavor: 命阙的野市只在无月之夜开张，卖什么全看你缺什么。

art.subject: a crowded night market in a ruined courtyard lit by paper lanterns, stalls of mysterious goods, hooded figures bargaining, mist drifting between the awnings

name: 百衲衣
text: 你的主帅受到的伤害-{r}。每当你献出一张牌，获得{a}点[护甲]。
flavor: 每一块补丁，都是一张献出去的牌换来的。

art.subject: a heavy quilted robe stitched from hundreds of mismatched cloth patches and small metal plates, hung on a wooden frame, faint glyphs glowing along the seams

name: 素玉璧
text: 每回合你第一次献牌时，抽{n}张牌。

upgrade.text: 每回合你第一次献牌时，抽{n}张牌，并获得{e}枚临时[源]。

flavor: 无纹无饰的玉，什么都盛得下。

art.subject: a flawless pale jade bi disc floating above an open palm, a card dissolving into white light as it passes through the central hole

name: 献火童子
text: 每当你献出一张牌，此单位获得+{n}/+{n}，然后对一个随机敌人造成等同于其攻击力的伤害。

upgrade.text: [灵障]。每当你献出一张牌，此单位获得+{n}/+{n}，然后对一个随机敌人造成等同于其攻击力的伤害。

flavor: 它吃的不是柴，是你舍掉的东西。

art.subject: a small child spirit in a white robe cradling a brazier, catching a falling card that bursts into white flame, sparks flying off toward the dark

name: 地脉灵泉
text: 获得{n}枚素[源]。[燃尽]。

upgrade.text: 获得{n}枚素[源]与{m}枚你主帅颜色的[源]。[燃尽]。

flavor: 凿开一寸岩层，涌出来的是三百年前的雨。

art.subject: a pick striking a cracked rock face and releasing a gush of luminous white spring water, droplets hanging in the air like pearls, cave darkness around

name: 移花接木
text: [应]：仅能在应对窗口中打出。将被应对的敌方行动改为以一个友方角色为目标。

upgrade.text: [应]：仅能在应对窗口中打出。将被应对的敌方行动改为以一个友方角色为目标，并使其获得{a}点[护甲]。

flavor: 刀还在半空，挨刀的人已经换了。

art.subject: a falling blade frozen mid-strike as a swirl of petals and leaves twists its path toward a raised shield on the other side, a figure stepping out of harm's way

name: 五行散人
text: [起势]：你的[源]中每有一种颜色，此单位获得+{b}/+{b}及对应能力：{R}[连斩]、{B}[坚守]、{G}[滋长]{b}、{Y}[灵障]、{P}[隐匿]。
flavor: 五宗都说他是叛徒，五宗都偷学过他的东西。

art.subject: a barefoot hermit in a white robe seated cross-legged in midair, five orbs of red, indigo, green, gold and violet light orbiting him slowly, a calm faint smile

name: 归墟炉
text: 你每回合可以额外献出{k}张牌。每当你献出一张牌，对一个随机敌人造成{d}点伤害。

upgrade.text: [本命]。你每回合可以额外献出{k}张牌。每当你献出一张牌，对一个随机敌人造成{d}点伤害。

flavor: 万物落进去，只剩一缕白烟，和一粒还在发烫的源。

art.subject: a colossal bronze furnace sunk into a bottomless chasm, cards and relics spiraling down into its white-hot mouth, pale smoke rising in a single column
